metadata.title: Secure Device Execution

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing trusted execution, control, and safety of physical and cyber-physical devices under Zero Trust principles.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Connected devices, embedded systems, cyber-physical platforms, IoT, OT, IoMT, robotics, vehicles, autonomous systems, and distributed sensors.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Zero Trust pattern assembling foundational execution, control, and safety mechanics for all device classes.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines device execution as a trust plane composed of identity, integrity, lifecycle, command, data, and safety signals.

metadata.remarks: Secure Device Execution composes all device security patterns into a coherent Zero Trust execution model. It defines how device trust is established, constrained, evaluated, and overlaid with safety requirements without granting implicit authorization, correctness, or regulatory compliance.

components.title: Device Core
components.description: Defines baseline execution eligibility and trust boundaries for devices.

components.title: Device Identity
components.description: Defines device identification and binding to execution context.

components.title: Device Attestation
components.description: Produces verifiable integrity evidence for device execution.

components.title: Device Lifecycle
components.description: Defines lifecycle states and trust-relevant transitions for devices.

components.title: Telemetry and Command Data Protection
components.description: Protects telemetry and command data exchanged by devices.

components.title: Command Integrity
components.description: Ensures authenticity, integrity, and bounding of device commands.

components.title: Change Management
components.description: Governs how device changes are introduced, tracked, and observed.

components.title: Engineering Access Control
components.description: Controls privileged access to engineering and maintenance interfaces.

components.title: Safety Zones and Conduits
components.description: Defines segmentation boundaries and mediated communication paths.

components.title: OT Safety Overlay
components.description: Applies IEC 62443 safety constraints to OT devices and environments.

components.title: IoMT Patient Safety Overlay
components.description: Applies patient safety constraints to medical devices and clinical environments.
